# Throttle Of

Source: [4752](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4752); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Throttle Of](../../api/values/throttle-of.md).

<a id="wiki-4752-n1"></a>

- Throttle Of is directional input, with horizontal input on X positive left and vertical input on Z positive upward in input terms.
